stepTitle: Which point is located at an angle of $$0$$ radians? \n A unit circle is centered on a coordinate plane. Four points, labeled A, B, C, and D, are located where the horizontal and vertical axes intersect the circle's circumference. Point A is located on the positive horizontal axis. Point B is located on the positive vertical axis. Point C is located on the negative horizontal axis. Point D is located on the negative vertical axis. The points are distributed evenly at the top, bottom, left, and rightmost edges of the circle.
